_doc: BattleTower_Lobby (zone 21), built by the specials agent (recipe data/interior_layouts/BattleTower_Lobby.json): Nimbasa Battle Test look, Black 2 interior area 306. A plain Sapphire room for now: the PWT link waits for the island and the story (notes/DECISIONS.md). Warps in Sapphire's order (warps 0/1 lead to BattleTower_Outside, not built yet: they point at this room's own warp 0 until the island exists). People (battle_tower agent, 2026-10-08): Sapphire's six objects by their local ids as uids, in uid order (index = uid - 1): the receptionist (TEALA = Teala, code 79 (data/sprite_map.json OBJ_EVENT_GFX_TEALA: Sapphire's own Teala redrawn, as in the Pokémon Centers)), MAN_5, WOMAN_7 and BOY_1 (uids 3/4, the specials agent's), the reporter and the award man (hidden by their flags); the records sign (3,5), read facing north. Scripts 3-7 are the battle_tower agent's.
